## Analysis

The carry-interacting digit sweep underperformed both `sol_0001` and `sol_0012`, refuting small-base products with a tiny second digit set as the missing mechanism. Across runs, large structured subsets remain the only lineage that improved the frontier: `sol_0012` reached 1.07944, while fixed-size local search repeatedly stalled at 1.07343. Its 277-point support is therefore likely overcomplete; systematic compression may reveal a stronger embedded subset that toggle-based annealing rarely reaches.

## Next

Starting from the exact `sol_0012` set, run a deterministic marginal-deletion beam search from `n=277` down to `n=32`, maintaining exact sum/difference multiplicities, beam width `16`, and retaining the best distinct children by exact \(C(A)\) at every size. Use the remaining time for single-swap repair over coordinates `[0,2244]`, checkpoint every strict improvement atomically, and stop at 165 seconds.
